summary: The proposal has a coherent topic, clearly identified stakeholders, four action-oriented objectives, two appropriately referenced diagrams, and a specific first-person AI transparency statement. However, it requires substantial revision because the bibliography is below the minimum, the text is too long, the schedule contains a date inconsistency and weak or prohibited tasks, and several section-level constraints are not fully met.

findings.title: Insufficient Number of Bibliography Entries
findings.description: The bibliography contains only five publications, below the required minimum of 6–8. Add at least one to three additional peer-reviewed scientific publications that directly support the problem, methodology, or evaluation.

findings.title: Proposal Exceeds Recommended Length
findings.description: The proposal text appears to exceed the recommended maximum of six text pages when figures, the schedule, and metadata are excluded. The objective descriptions alone extend across several pages. Condense repeated explanations and remove implementation details that are not necessary at proposal level.

locations.quote: 4 Objective ... **4.1 Generate Feedback Based on Guidelines**
We extend the existing proposal feedback flow to also cover the thesis, enabling formative feedback during the writing of the thesis itself.

findings.title: Problem Section Is Too Long
findings.description: The Problem section appears to exceed the maximum length of three-quarters of a page. Reduce background context and retain only the problem, its consequences, and the affected actors.

locations.quote: For students’ research proposals and theses, supervisors often provide feedback that is critical to their progress.
While the problem is less severe for students, they still experience its consequences.

findings.title: Schedule Starts Before the Thesis
findings.description: The first iteration is scheduled before the stated thesis start date. Align all iteration dates with the project period beginning on 26.06.2026, or correct the stated start date and explain the overlap.

locations.quote: The Bachelor thesis starts on **26.06.2026** ... Iteration 1 (**08.06.2026 - 2 weeks**)

findings.title: Final Iteration Has Vague and Prohibited Tasks
findings.description: The final iteration contains vague work items and a prohibited documentation task. Replace them with measurable, research or development deliverables such as a defined evaluation report, test results, defect-resolution criteria, or completed benchmark dataset; remove thesis or project documentation from the schedule.

locations.quote:
• **Review the system and check for bugs**
• **Documentation**

findings.title: Motivation Repeats the Problem
findings.description: The Motivation section partly repeats the Problem section by restating that repetitive feedback drains supervisors. Replace this problem summary with a concise statement of the desired scientific and educational future state.

locations.quote: This Reviewer covers exactly the repetitive, non-content-related layer of feedback that **currently drains supervisors**...

findings.title: AI Statement Does Not Identify Proposal Sections
findings.description: The AI transparency statement names tools, purposes, and confirms review, but it does not identify the proposal sections in which each tool was used. Add explicit section references, for example, stating which tools assisted with the Abstract, Introduction, Objectives, Schedule, or AI statement.

locations.section: Transparency in the Use of AI Tools
locations.quote: I made use of several AI-based tools across different stages of the writing process.

findings.title: Prohibited Sentence Starters
findings.description: Three sentences begin with prohibited starters. Rewrite them with explicit subjects or alternative constructions, for example, 'Figure 1 illustrates...', 'Guidelines may not...', and 'The feedback tool's use...'.

locations.quote: **As Figure 1 illustrates**, an LLM-powered Reviewer works alongside the supervisor...
**Since guidelines may not already be in a suitable format**, the LLM may first need to preprocess them...
**Because the feedback tool is powered by LLMs**, students can obtain instant formative feedback...
